text:
The bowl is stainless steel, roughly 20 cm across at the rim, and holds shredded carrots plus about 8 grape tomatoes.

Carrots: the pile looks like about 50-60 g. Tomatoes: each weighs about 10-12 g, so 8 come to roughly 90 g. Total mass is about 150 g.

Energy: carrots at about 41 kcal per 100 g give roughly 23 kcal for 55 g. Tomatoes at about 18 kcal per 100 g give roughly 16 kcal for 90 g. That totals about 40 kcal. There is no visible dressing, so I'll round up slightly to allow for some.
